Write a reply message to the following comment:
I bought an art piece from Elle, an artist I met on Etsy, and connected with her personally. To avoid Etsy's fees, we moved our transactions to Facebook. Despite slow shipping, Elle always communicated about delays. However, my last purchase from 5 months ago hasn't arrived yet, even though the payment was cashed immediately. After promises of shipping it in December and multiple excuses including family illness, I received nothing. By February, after several unanswered attempts to reach her, I learned she's active on Instagram, teaching art business. I demanded a refund through a formal document, highlighting her failure to deliver. Elle replied, citing severe health issues as the reason for her unresponsiveness and offered a refund, stating her husband is managing most shipments now.

Write a reply message to the following comment:
I [31M] invested in an expensive road bike as my main transport, but last week, it was stolen and captured on security footage by my cousin Brad [15M]. By the time I reported it and his parents confronted him, the bike was stolen from Brad too. I requested reimbursement from Brad's wealthy parents, but learned they're facing financial issues due to my uncle's [50s M] job loss and addictions. Despite their hardships, I feel no sympathy due to their past arrogance towards my family. I gave my uncle an ultimatum to pay for the bike by Sunday midnight or I'd report the theft to the police with all evidence. The deadline has passed without payment, so I plan to report Brad to the police tomorrow.

Write a reply message to the following comment:
I turned 40 recently and had booked a 7pm dinner at a nice restaurant. Planning to leave at 6:30pm to account for traffic and picking up my dad, I found my husband (43 M) still working on his car, not ready to go. Despite urging him to hurry, by 6:50, he wasn't ready, so I left with the kids, not wanting to miss our reservation. He often runs late, but I couldn't tolerate it for my special dinner. We kept our table despite arriving late, but my husband didn't join us and was upset upon our return. I expressed my frustration with his habitual tardiness. My dad supported my decision, though the kids were disappointed he missed the dinner.

Write a reply message to the following comment:
On my 25th birthday, I chose pie over cake, buying two pies to enjoy freely, despite my boyfriend's usual complaints about my pie consumption. Over three days, I finished both pies and consumed 10 sodas, which angered my boyfriend. He warned me against repeating this on my next birthday, citing health concerns. This reaction was surprising, especially since I've recovered from anorexia three years ago and generally eat healthier than he does. He often indulges in sweets and sodas without restraint. When confronted, I apologized, but he persisted, accusing me of not handling serious discussions well, which I felt was more reflective of his behavior. Given my history with food, I wonder if I was wrong for indulging during my birthday celebration.
